connector.name: naia GEO Autopilot
connector.registryDescription: Autopilot MCP server for GEO analyses, reports, content, audits, memories and agents.
connector.summary: Hosted at naia.today over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package naia-mcp-server. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace today.naia. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Bearer token generated in the naia dashboard, for example: Bearer naia_your_key

env.name: NAIA_API_KEY
env.description: naia API key generated in Dashboard > Settings > API

env.name: NAIA_MCP_URL
env.description: Optional override for the naia MCP endpoint. Defaults to https://naia.today/api/v1/mcp.
